h1: Do I need a permit to place a construction dumpster or storage container on the street in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Dumpster and POD Permits: Street and Public-Way Placement
description: Find out which City office to contact before placing a dumpster or storage container in a street or public right-of-way.
short_answer: The official sources reviewed do not establish one complete Newton permit rule for every dumpster or storage container. A container placed in a public street, sidewalk, or other public right-of-way should be reviewed with the City before delivery. Placement on private property should also be checked for zoning, access, and site restrictions.

facts.text: Newton Engineering reviews work and site conditions involving the public right-of-way.
Newton ISD and other City departments administer separate permits for work under their respective authority.

qa.q: Can I place a dumpster on the street without contacting the City?
qa.a: Do not assume that public-way placement is allowed without approval. Confirm the current street-occupancy or right-of-way process with Newton before delivery.
